description:
Get the status, cost and pictures of one card pack.

status: queued/processing (the pack is being built: progress_pct says how far, ask again in a minute or two),
completed or failed (nothing stays charged). When completed, give the user output.images: index 0 with role
clean is the cleaned product photo, the rest are the slides (cover first), each with its url, role and headline.
output.warnings are machine codes such as cover_qa_failed or slide_qa_failed:2: a check the picture did not pass
even after a retry; say so if the user asks why a slide looks off. Links are signed and last about a day: call
again for fresh ones.
name: get_marketplace_cards
